chest.name: Chest
chest.does: Pushes your arms forward and across your body. The upper fibers make the shelf under the collarbone that shows in a tank top.

delts_front.name: Front shoulder
delts_front.does: Lifts your arm forward. Works in every press, so it rarely needs much extra.

delts_side.name: Side shoulder
delts_side.does: Lifts your arm out to the side. This is the muscle that makes shoulders look wide and capped.

delts_rear.name: Rear shoulder
delts_rear.does: Pulls your arm back. Rounds the shoulder from behind and keeps you from slouching.

biceps.name: Biceps
biceps.does: Bends the elbow and turns the palm up. The brachialis underneath pushes the biceps up for a taller peak.

triceps.name: Triceps
triceps.does: Straightens the elbow. About two thirds of upper-arm size.

forearms.name: Forearms and grip
forearms.does: Close your hand and hold the bar. Climbing strength lives here.

abs.name: Abs
abs.does: Curls your ribs toward your hips. The six-pack muscle. It shows when body fat is low and it is thick.

obliques.name: Obliques
obliques.does: Twist and side-bend your trunk. They frame the abs and tighten the waist.

hip_flexors.name: Hip flexors
hip_flexors.does: Lift your knee toward your chest. Work hard in leg raises and sprinting.

traps.name: Traps
traps.does: Shrug and hold your shoulders back. The upper part shows beside the neck in a tank top.

upper_back.name: Upper back
upper_back.does: Pull your shoulder blades together. Posture and a thick back.

lats.name: Lats
lats.does: Pull your arms down and back. Width of the back. The pull-up muscle.

lower_back.name: Lower back
lower_back.does: Keep your spine straight under load.

glutes.name: Glutes
glutes.does: Drive your hips forward. The main engine for jumping and sprinting.

quads.name: Quads
quads.does: Straighten the knee. They push the floor away when you jump.

hamstrings.name: Hamstrings
hamstrings.does: Bend the knee and extend the hip. Protect the knee when you land.

adductors.name: Inner thigh
adductors.does: Pull the legs together and help in deep squats.

calves.name: Calves
calves.does: Point the foot. The last push off the ground in a jump.
